Phumla Kamnandi Hotel group is a new South African empowerment group etsbalished last year. With over 30 hotels in the group, each run independently. Although our hotels vary in size, facilities and character, they all share one vision, which is to deliver exceptional service and comfortable accomodation at an afforadable price. Our guests can expect the same high-quality experience at every Phumla Kamnandi Hotel, no matter where they stay. From our head office in Century City, Cape Town, we handle group marketing, customer loyalty and IT support to create a seamless experience that inspires guests to return, time and again. As we continue to grow, we're focused on one goal: making every stay a truly luxurious, relaxing and memorable Phumla Kamnandi experience.
Our facilities: -24-hour in Room service -Laundry and Housekeeping -Babysitting services upon request -2 Bars and Resturants -Swimming Pool -Gym and Game Rooms -Tennis, Horse riding and Bowls
Our Founders: Vanessa Mokoena Razina Chikte Camryn Pillay Nurah Kamal
